title: With God All Things Are Possible

request.style: English, male baritone solo with ethereal choir, organ, harp, strings, timpani, solemn and majestic, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
It is hard for a rich man to enter
The kingdom of heaven is far from him
A camel through the eye of a needle
Is easier than his path to God

[Pre-Chorus]
The disciples asked who can be saved
When such a heavy burden is laid

[Chorus]
With people this is impossible
But with God all things are possible
With people this is impossible
But with God all things are possible

[Verse]
We left everything to follow you
What will there be for us in turn
At the renewal of all things
When the Son of Man sits on glory

[Chorus]
With people this is impossible
But with God all things are possible
With people this is impossible
But with God all things are possible

[Verse]
You will sit on twelve thrones
Judging the twelve tribes of Israel
Leaving houses, brothers, sisters
For my name you will inherit life

[Chorus]
With people this is impossible
But with God all things are possible
With people this is impossible
But with God all things are possible

[Outro]
Hundred times as much is given
Eternal life is yours to have
